pool.comment: Phase 1-2 run against a simulated pool per PLAN.md 2.1.1. Live capital gate: >=10k ETF wheel, >=25k full design.

volFreeze.comment: PLAN.md 2.5 specified VIX > 30; Alpaca serves no VIX index, so the freeze uses 20-day SPY realized vol annualized > 30% as the deterministic proxy.

execution.comment: Paper-phase execution mechanics (2026-09-17, after all 5 first orders expired unfilled at mid): entries price at mid - fraction*spread (never below bid+0.01), marketable 21-DTE closes at mid + fraction*spread. Signal rules unchanged - wheel-v1 attribution is unaffected.

swing.comment: PLAN.md 2.4: shadow-only until it beats SPY-on-the-same-dates over a 6-month live-forward window (clock starts at first signal). Entry: close above 100d SMA (uptrend) and below 20d SMA (pullback). Bracket from a close-to-close volatility proxy (no intraday H/L on the free feed). One position per symbol; no orders of any kind in any mode.
